contradiction.claim: Went straight from the Break Room to the Server Room at about 18:50 and never went near the Clean Room.

explanation: Tom entered the Clean Room at 18:52, opened the carrier with the torque driver he is trained on (clue 2), hid the chip under a Loading Dock shelf at 19:02 (clue 3), and only reached the Server Room at 19:08. He hoped to sell it to Corvex. Hannah's Corvex job application (clue 1) is a red herring: the log never puts her in the Clean Room.
